function.name: get_local_time
function.description: Retrieve the current local time in a specified time zone. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

timezone.description: The timezone for which local time needs to be calculated.

date_format.description: The format in which the date and time should be returned. Default is 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss'.

message.content: 倫敦所在的時區是 **Europe/London**。在冬季使用格林威治標準時間（GMT，UTC+0），夏季則使用英國夏令時間（BST，UTC+1）。
message.reasoning:
User asks: "倫敦的時區是什麼？" They want the time zone of London. We can answer: London is in the UK, uses GMT (UTC+0) in winter, BST (UTC+1) in summer. But maybe they want the timezone name: "Europe/London". So we can respond: "London is in the Europe/London time zone (GMT/UTC+0 in winter, BST/UTC+1 in summer)."

We can also provide the current local time. But the user didn't ask for current time. They just asked "倫敦的時區是什麼？" So we can answer with the timezone name. We can also mention that it's in the UK. So answer: "London is in the Europe/London time zone (GMT/UTC+0 in winter, BST/UTC+1 in summer)."

We can also mention that the timezone abbreviation is GMT or BST depending on DST. So answer accordingly.
